product_metadata.title: Hallmark Large Easter Canvas Tote Bag (Bunny Ears) for Easter Baskets, Egg Hunts, Spring Birthdays and More
features: Large canvas tote bag measures 8" wide x 10.7" tall.
Perfect for holding Easter or spring birthday presents like clothing, games, or puzzles; collecting Easter eggs at an Easter egg hunt; or carrying library books.
Ivory fabric bag features a cute bunny face and is finished with two rainbow bunny ear handles for easy over-the-shoulder carrying.
Festive design is a perfect substitute for a traditional Easter basket or works well as a treat grab bag or party favor bag for parties in classrooms or at home.
Reusable Easter gift bag is an way to celebrate the holiday year after year
description: Present the best Easter treats this year in this festive large canvas bag. Ivory tote bag features a cheerful Easter bunny design making it perfect for carrying on an Easter egg hunt or passing out party favors in the classroom. The bag holds a variety of great gifts like a costume, books, and puzzles, and is a cute way for teachers or volunteers to carry books to and from a Halloween story hour. The Hallmark brand is widely recognized as the very best for greeting cards, gift wrap, and more. For more than 100 years, Hallmark has been helping its customers make everyday moments more beautiful and celebrations more joyful.
